reason: My walls are not peeling yet, so I am not spending more than a month's salary on painting this month. And I live in a flat, the outside is the association's job, so half of this package is no use to me anyway.
objection: Once they take the money, will Turbolux's own people still pick up the phone, or will some subcontractor crew turn up, clash with our building's contractor hours, miss the date and then stop answering when there is a problem?
would_change_my_mind: An interior-only flat price, with one named Turbolux person I can call who answers, and a crew that works within our building's contractor hours, offered when damp patches actually show up.
